title: AWFUL VERY STRONG ODOR
text: AWFUL VERY STRONG ODOR. I'm not sure if it's the ink, or the chemicals used to make these small wrappers leak proof, but I would not use them to wrap anything, let alone FOOD. They state wax paper. I could find no wax on these. I returned these.
